## FLOOWBOX - Salary Benchmarking
Send role + years experience + location.
3 parallel Perplexity searches:
- India salaries by company type (startup/MNC)
- Global salary comparison (US, UK, UAE, SG, CA)
- Skill premium data per technology
GPT-4o compiles benchmark with negotiation tips.
Saves to Google Sheets salary database.

Useful for: salary negotiations, offer evaluation, hiring budget planning.
